what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Guatemala, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 636 Salvadoran refugees in Guatemala, 0.9% of all refugees from El Salvador.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador from 1979 to 1991, with the FMLN among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1981 to 1984, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 4130 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 100000, at the end of 1981, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Guatemala.
These are year-end totals for Guatemala only, reported to UNHCR.
